## Wave 8 Summary

Wave 8 OPERATIONALIZES the external reviewer's two orthogonal recommendations on the living capstone `sessions/framework/phonic-exflation-equation.md`: **(A) status-synchronization** (the capstone is not fully synchronized with the repo-wide status registers — Atlas D04 assumptions, the Atlas D09 retraction log, the registry) and **(B) publication-discipline** (modularize the math core from the cosmology claims, prove/bound the `D_K ≅ D_F` NCG departure, ship a minimal reproducible bundle, anchor primary-literature citations, split the §7 "now" table into three registers, declare the 3-stratum layered-program structure explicitly).

The reviewer's central diagnosis: *"version synchronization has become a substantive scholarly issue rather than a cosmetic one"* — and its single most-cited concrete instance is **§5.3 GGE-permanence** (capstone narrates an integrable relic; Atlas D04 **T3 = BROKEN**, retraction-log **item 16 = RETRACTION**, thermalizes `t_therm ~ 6 M_KK⁻¹`) plus **§6.2 horizon-language** (capstone narrates an acoustic white hole; retraction-log **item 22** retracted the S48 analog-horizon claim — *no superflow, `φ=0`, amplitude gradients ≠ phase gradients*). Several `_consolidated-findings.md §III` panel dissonances are themselves status-drift instances: **D1** (`LEGGETT-GRAV-DECAY-67` PASS-vs-CRITICAL-open), **D2** (GGE-relic-IS-CMB vs hot-big-bang SCENARIO A), **D5** ("no seesaw" §0 vs S60 seesaw `m_2=0.008678 eV`), plus the **C4** `f_NL` bound-mislabeled-as-point.

**Sequencing (RUN-EARLY).** W8-1 (status-sync) and W8-3 (standing hygiene gate) are **Wave-0 class — run BEFORE the ambitious compute waves W1–W7** per the reviewer's *"synchronize before getting more ambitious."* The recommended dispatch order is **W8-1/W8-3 → W1–W7 → remaining W8 publication-discipline gates (W8-2, W8-4, W8-5, W8-6, W8-7)**. W8-2 (3-register table) consumes W8-1's status-diff and SHOULD land after W8-1; W8-4/W8-5/W8-6/W8-7 are independent of W8-1 and may run in the late batch.

**Class split.** Five of the seven gates are **METHODOLOGY-class** (capstone / rule / registry edits whose PASS predicate is artifact-existence-with-substantive-content per `wave-classification.md` M1, with a `content_sha256` over the diff) — **W8-1, W8-2, W8-3, W8-6, W8-7**. Each satisfies the M1–M4 strict conjunction and **REQUIRES ORCHESTRATOR ALLOWLIST APPEND** at plan-freeze (gate-IDs flagged in each block's `# ---- METHODOLOGY-class M1-M4 self-classification ----` footer; consolidated in the §"Wave 8 Allowlist-Append Manifest" table below). Two gates are **COMPUTE/structural** — **W8-4** (the `D_K ≅ D_F` equivalence / controlled low-energy recovery theorem, the reviewer's highest-burden math step) and **W8-5** (the frozen end-to-end reproducer + locked env manifest, infra/COMPUTE).

**Curated-doc discipline (load-bearing).** The capstone is a CURATED framework document (`feedback_framework-hygiene.md`: *"`sessions/framework/` is curated — no bulk dumps"*). W8-1/W8-2/W8-7 pre-register their capstone edits as a **designated-writer edit at `/rclab-coordinate` time, NOT a bulk install-agents append**: the gate's producing script emits the **status-diff** (a structured, reviewable patch artifact) and the sole designated writer (`gen-physicist` for §5.3/§6.2/§6.3/§7-prose/modularization; `mack-cosmic-bridge` for the §7 falsifier-table 3-register split per `feedback_mack-bridge-role.md` sole-writer) applies it. No gate bulk-appends to the capstone.

**Per-gate agent_type** (per partition §"Per-gate agent_type"): `connes-ncg-theorist` (W8-4); `mack-cosmic-bridge` (W8-2, the falsifier/observable table); `gen-physicist` (W8-1, W8-3, W8-5, W8-6, W8-7).

```yaml
# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  The capstone is status-synchronized with the repo-wide register: every mandatory claim (§5.3 GGE-permanence,
  §6.2 horizon-language, §7.1 status-row set, D1, D2, D5, C4-f_NL) has a reconciled row matching its current
  Atlas-D04 / retraction-log / registry / knowledge-MCP status tag; the status-diff cleanly separates numerical
  revisions (σ-band re-pins) from structural status-tag changes (epistemic-type reclassifications); and the
  designated-writer patch lands with ZERO sections narrating a claim above its register status. Solution-space:
  the capstone becomes a "stable scholarly object" (report §"Recommended next analyses") — the version-
  synchronization scholarly issue is closed; downstream citations cannot drift to over-confident phrasing.
FAIL_meaning: >
  At least one mandatory claim is missing a reconciled row, OR the status-diff conflates numerical and structural
  changes in one block (output-standards.md violation), OR the re-grep finds a residual over-confident narration
  (e.g. "never thermalizes" without a BROKEN/transit qualifier; §6.2 white-hole text without the item-22
  reconciliation note; a §7.1 Status cell stronger than its register). Solution-space: the capstone is NOT yet
  publication-stable; FAIL routes to completing the missing reconciliation before W8-2 (the 3-register table)
  can run — W8-2 honestly closes PRE-REG-INC pending this gate per mechanical-closure-discipline.md.
INFO_meaning: >
  The reconciliation table + status-diff are complete and the patch lands, BUT one or more dissonances (D2 GGE-IS-CMB,
  D5 seesaw) are flagged as GENUINELY UNRECONCILED at the substrate-physics level (their resolution requires the
  W6/W4 compute gates, not a status-tag edit). Registry state: the capstone carries an explicit "STATUS: unreconciled
  — see W6 D2 / W4 D5" pointer on the affected cross-reference, and the status-diff records the dissonance as a
  forward-routed compute item (NOT a status-tag fix). This is the honest INFO when a dissonance is a math/physics
  adjudication (Q1-YES per Investigating-Workshops.md), not a documentation drift.
```

```yaml
  capstone §0. Solution-space: the one-off W8-1 status-sync becomes a recurring discipline — every future
  session touching the capstone or its governing registers MUST answer the 5 questions at close, closing the
  status-drift failure mode BY CONSTRUCTION (the report's recurring-process recommendation is operationalized).
FAIL_meaning: >

  lacks the Q1-Q5 detector or the self-test, OR the cross-links are absent, OR the rule body carries session
  IDs/per-instance narrative (feedback_rules-directive-only-no-session-info.md violation). Solution-space: the
  standing gate is not yet enforceable; FAIL routes to completing the rule + hook before the gate is cited as
  an active discipline.
INFO_meaning: >
  The rule + hook land, BUT the K-counter promotion status is GENUINELY at K=1 (SUGGESTION) and the gate
  cannot yet be MANDATORY (it has caught fewer than 3 distinct real drifts). Registry state: the rule ships as
  SUGGESTION-at-K=1 with the explicit K=3-MANDATORY promotion path recorded; the audit hook emits S2 advisory
  (not S1 HARD-HALT) until promotion. This is the honest INFO for a new rule entering at K=1 (NOT a failure —
  the SUGGESTION→MANDATORY contract is the designed lifecycle per feedback_rules-compensate-missing-structure.md).

substrate_framing: |

  the methodology-layer analog of a substrate-IS conserved quantity (the conservation law: no capstone claim
```

## §W8-4. S96-CONSOL-DK-DF-EQUIV

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S96-CONSOL-DK-DF-EQUIV"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY-THEOREM]"   # the highest-burden NCG departure: a dedicated D_K ≅ D_F equivalence / controlled low-energy recovery theorem
classification: "GEOMETRIC"   # a property of the spectral triple structure (D_K eigenvalues / the almost-commutative product geometry), the fabric itself
agent_type: "connes-ncg-theorist"
hypothesis: >
  The capstone's boldest NCG departure — identifying the SU(3)-manifold internal Dirac operator D_K with
  the role mainstream almost-commutative NCG assigns to a FINITE internal Dirac operator D_F — is justified
  NOT by standard NCG authority but by a controlled low-energy recovery theorem: below the KK threshold
  M_KK, the heat-kernel / spectral-action low-energy expansion of the SU(3)-manifold triple
  (A_K, H_K, D_K) reproduces the almost-commutative Standard-Model triple (A_F=ℂ⊕ℍ⊕M_3(ℂ), H_F, D_F)
  up to the zero-mode (constant-mode) sector, with the KK tower contributing only suppressed O((E/M_KK)^2)
  corrections; equivalently, the constant-mode projection of D_K ON SU(3) IS D_F at the bottom of the tower.

method:
  description: >
    A dedicated equivalence / controlled-low-energy-recovery theorem for the D_K ≅ D_F departure (report
    §"Critique of theory" — "the boldest and most interesting move... cannot rely on standard NCG authority
    alone... needs a dedicated section proving equivalence, or at least a controlled low-energy recovery
    theorem"). THREE deliverables:
    (a) STRUCTURAL STATEMENT: the precise sense of "≅". In mainstream NCG the total triple is the product
        M_4 × F with D_total = D_M ⊗ 1_F + γ_5 ⊗ D_F (S70 connes-synthesis; S19d), F a FINITE geometry. The
        capstone replaces F with the SU(3)-manifold K, so D_total = D_{M_4} ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ D_K + [γ_5 cross terms]
        and D^2 = D_{M_4}^2 ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ D_K^2 + [cross] (S19d). The theorem's claim is: the LOW-LYING spectrum
        of D_K on the L_max=10/12 cache, projected to the constant-mode (Peter-Weyl trivial-rep / bottom-K)
        sector, carries the SAME finite-dimensional data (algebra A_F=ℂ⊕ℍ⊕M_3(ℂ) via N2; the Ψ_+=ℂ^16 SM
        spectrum via G5; KO-dim=6 via G4) as the almost-commutative D_F — and the higher Peter-Weyl modes are
        the KK tower (suppressed below M_KK). This is a CONTROLLED LOW-ENERGY RECOVERY (D_F is the E→0 limit of
        D_K's constant-mode sector), NOT a full isometric equivalence of the two triples (which is dimensionally
        impossible: SU(3) is 8-dim, F is 0-dim — cite epistemic-discipline.md §"Quotient-functor pre-registration"
        for the ∞-dim-manifold ↔ finite-rank disparity).
    (b) NUMERICAL RECOVERY CHECK: from the cached D_K spectrum at L_max=10/12, extract the bottom-K constant-mode
        sector eigenvalues and verify they reproduce (i) the A_F=ℂ⊕ℍ⊕M_3(ℂ) Wedderburn block structure (N2/N7
        Frobenius rescue: ℂ+ℍ n=1 Frobenius division, M_3(ℂ) χ-killed — Atlas D04 N7 PROVEN STAGE-3); (ii) the
        KO-dim=6 invariant on the constant-mode sub-triple (G4 PROVEN, 10 checks <1e-15); (iii) the SM-quantum-
        number multiplet structure on Ψ_+ (G5 PROVEN). The KK-suppression check: the gap between the constant-
        mode sector and the first non-trivial Peter-Weyl sector is ~M_KK (the bottom of the tower), so the E≪M_KK
        recovery is controlled. The recovery RESIDUAL (how far the constant-mode reduction is from a literal D_F)
        is the gate's value.
    (c) HONEST-SCOPE DECLARATION: the theorem proves a controlled LOW-ENERGY RECOVERY, NOT a full triple
        isomorphism; the residual cokernel content (the KK tower) is explicitly named as killed by the E→0 /
        constant-mode quotient (per the quotient-functor pre-registration discipline). The bare-axiom status
        (Atlas D04 N3 = BROKEN at bare-axiom level; axiom-5 orientability fails at 4.000 for the M_3(ℂ) sector,
        rescued STAGE-3-PERMANENT by the Wedderburn-Frobenius class N7) is carried INTACT — the recovery theorem
        does NOT claim to repair the bare-axiom fail; it shows the SM-relevant content is recovered at low energy
        GIVEN the rescue class.
    Sage-MCP (sage_symbolic_eig / sage_simplify) verifies the constant-mode block structure symbolically where
    tractable; the cached L_max=10/12 spectrum supplies the numerical recovery check. The verdict is whether the
    constant-mode recovery residual is below a pre-registered floor (PASS = D_F recovered to the floor; FAIL =
    the constant-mode sector does NOT reproduce the A_F/KO-dim/SM data, the departure is unjustified at low
    energy; INFO = recovered with a controlled but non-zero residual flagged as the KK-tower-suppression scale).
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s96_consol_dk_df_equiv.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "equality"   # the constant-mode recovery: does the bottom-K sector of D_K reproduce the D_F data?
  form: >
    PASS iff ALL of: (i) the constant-mode (bottom-K trivial-rep) sector of D_K reproduces the A_F=ℂ⊕ℍ⊕M_3(ℂ)
                          Wedderburn block structure (block-dimension match to the N2/N7 rescue class);
                     (ii) KO-dim of the constant-mode sub-triple == 6 (G4 invariant preserved, |dev| < 1e-12);
                     (iii) the SM-multiplet structure on Ψ_+=ℂ^16 recovered (G5);
                     (iv) the KK-suppression gap (constant-mode sector ↔ first non-trivial Peter-Weyl sector) ~ M_KK
                          (controlled low-energy separation); recovery_residual < 1e-6 (relative).

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "recovery_residual < 1e-6 (relative) on the constant-mode block-structure + KO-dim + SM-multiplet recovery; KK-suppression gap / M_KK in [0.5, 2] (controlled separation)"
  direction: "<"   # the recovery residual below the floor

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    Partially analytic. The product-triple structure D_total = D_M ⊗ 1 + γ_5 ⊗ D_F is the standard NCG
    almost-commutative form (CCM 2007; Connes-Marcolli); the SU(3)-manifold replacement and D^2 cross-term
    structure are S19d / S70 connes-synthesis. The constant-mode (Peter-Weyl trivial-rep) sector reduction is
    analytic: the trivial rep contributes the L_max-independent bottom of D_K^2 (the block-diagonal G10 theorem
    guarantees the Peter-Weyl decomposition D_K = ⊕_{(p,q)} D_{(p,q)}; the (0,0) sector is the constant-mode
    block). The A_F=ℂ⊕ℍ⊕M_3(ℂ) recovery is the N2/N7 Wedderburn-Frobenius rescue (Atlas D04, STAGE-3-PERMANENT);
    KO-dim=6 is G4 (PROVEN, 10 checks <1e-15). The KK-suppression gap is the bottom-of-tower scale ~M_KK. The
    recovery_residual floor 1e-6 is the resolvable separation between a literal D_F-block-match and the L_max=10/12
    truncation noise. Derivation block in the producing-script docstring + a Sage-MCP symbolic block-structure check.

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "the Peter-Weyl (p,q) sectors are on the integer mesh; the constant-mode sector is (0,0); the A_F block dimensions {1 (ℂ), 4 (ℍ as 2×2 real), 9 (M_3(ℂ))} and KO-dim=6 are exact integers; recovery checked against these integer invariants"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:

  regulator_pin: "a_2^{ζ}, a_4^{ζ}  (the low-energy spectral-action expansion coefficients are zeta-regulated Gilkey coefficients; tagged per regulator-pin-discipline.md; the recovery is at the a_2/a_4 moment level — the EH + YM+Higgs content D_F encodes; bare a_n FORBIDDEN)"
```
